interpretationWarning: A code identifies a stated withholding or review basis; it does not establish the release status of the whole document. Preserve the exact marking, page legend, agency, and official source.

codes.shortDefinition: Properly classified national-defense or foreign-policy information.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects information specifically authorized under an Executive order to be kept secret for national defense or foreign policy and properly classified under that order.
codes.notes: The marking does not show which E.O. 13526 category applies unless a separate code is present.

codes.shortDefinition: Internal agency personnel rules and practices.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects matters related solely to an agency's internal personnel rules and practices.

codes.shortDefinition: Information withheld under another qualifying federal statute.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects information specifically exempted from disclosure by another federal statute that meets FOIA's statutory criteria.
codes.notes: A bare b3 marking is incomplete for research purposes; record the cited withholding statute when it is visible.

codes.shortDefinition: Trade secrets and protected commercial or financial information.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects trade secrets and commercial or financial information obtained from a person that is privileged or confidential.

codes.shortDefinition: Protected inter-agency or intra-agency communications.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects inter-agency or intra-agency memoranda or letters that would not be available by law to a party in litigation with the agency.
codes.notes: The deliberative-process privilege does not apply under b5 to records created 25 years or more before the request.

codes.shortDefinition: Personal-privacy information in personnel, medical, or similar files.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects personnel, medical, and similar files when disclosure would constitute a clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy.

codes.shortDefinition: Law-enforcement records subject to one or more specified harms.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects records or information compiled for law-enforcement purposes only to the extent that a listed harm in subparts A through F would result.
codes.notes: Record the lettered subcode whenever visible.

codes.shortDefinition: Disclosure could interfere with enforcement proceedings.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects law-enforcement information when production could reasonably be expected to interfere with enforcement proceedings.

codes.shortDefinition: Disclosure would impair fair-trial or impartial-adjudication rights.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects law-enforcement information when production would deprive a person of a right to a fair trial or an impartial adjudication.

codes.shortDefinition: Law-enforcement information implicating personal privacy.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects law-enforcement information when production could reasonably be expected to constitute an unwarranted invasion of personal privacy.

codes.shortDefinition: Confidential-source identity or protected source-furnished information.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects the identity of a confidential source and, in specified investigations, information furnished by a confidential source.

codes.shortDefinition: Protected law-enforcement techniques, procedures, or guidelines.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects law-enforcement techniques and procedures, or guidelines when disclosure could reasonably be expected to risk circumvention of law.

codes.shortDefinition: Disclosure could endanger life or physical safety.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects law-enforcement information when production could reasonably be expected to endanger the life or physical safety of an individual.

codes.shortDefinition: Financial-institution supervision information.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects information contained in or related to examination, operating, or condition reports prepared by, for, or for the use of an agency responsible for regulating or supervising financial institutions.

codes.shortDefinition: Geological and geophysical well information and maps.
codes.detailedDefinition: Protects geological and geophysical information and data, including maps, concerning wells.

codes.shortDefinition: National-security classified information.
codes.detailedDefinition: Presidential-record restriction category for information properly classified in the interest of national defense or foreign policy.
codes.notes: A specific library withdrawal-sheet legend controls.

codes.shortDefinition: Federal-office appointment information.
codes.detailedDefinition: Presidential-record restriction category for information relating to appointments to federal office.
codes.notes: A specific library withdrawal-sheet legend controls.

codes.shortDefinition: Release prohibited by federal statute.
codes.detailedDefinition: Presidential-record restriction category for information specifically exempted from disclosure by another statute.
codes.notes: Record the cited statute when visible.

codes.shortDefinition: Trade-secret or protected commercial or financial information.
codes.detailedDefinition: Presidential-record restriction category for trade secrets and commercial or financial information obtained from a person that is privileged or confidential.
codes.notes: A specific library withdrawal-sheet legend controls.

codes.shortDefinition: Confidential advice involving the President or presidential advisers.
codes.detailedDefinition: Presidential-record restriction category for confidential communications requesting or submitting advice between the President and advisers, or among advisers.
codes.notes: A specific library withdrawal-sheet legend controls.

codes.shortDefinition: Clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy.
codes.detailedDefinition: Presidential-record restriction category for personnel, medical, or similar files whose disclosure would constitute a clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy.
codes.notes: A specific library withdrawal-sheet legend controls.

codes.shortDefinition: Military plans, weapons systems, or operations.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning military plans, weapons systems, or operations.
codes.notes: A category code is not itself a release-completeness determination.

codes.shortDefinition: Foreign-government information.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning foreign-government information.

codes.shortDefinition: Intelligence activities, sources, methods, or cryptology.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning intelligence activities, intelligence sources or methods, or cryptology.

codes.shortDefinition: Foreign relations or foreign activities, including confidential sources.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning foreign relations or foreign activities of the United States, including confidential sources.

codes.shortDefinition: National-security scientific, technological, or economic matters.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning scientific, technological, or economic matters relating to national security.

codes.shortDefinition: U.S. nuclear-material or facility safeguarding programs.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning U.S. Government programs for safeguarding nuclear materials or facilities.

codes.shortDefinition: National-security systems, installations, infrastructures, projects, plans, or protection services.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning vulnerabilities or capabilities of systems, installations, infrastructures, projects, plans, or protection services.

codes.shortDefinition: Development, production, or use of weapons of mass destruction.
codes.detailedDefinition: National-security information concerning the development, production, or use of weapons of mass destruction.

codes.shortDefinition: Confidential human source, human-intelligence source, or intelligence-method identity.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year automatic-declassification exemption for information revealing specified source identities or the application of an intelligence method.
codes.notes: Legacy 25X notation should be read with the document's legend and date.

codes.shortDefinition: Weapons-of-mass-destruction development, production, or use.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information assisting in developing, producing, or using weapons of mass destruction.

codes.shortDefinition: U.S. cryptologic systems or activities.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information revealing U.S. cryptologic systems or activities.

codes.shortDefinition: State-of-the-art weapons technology.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information revealing information that would impair state-of-the-art technology within a U.S. weapons system.

codes.shortDefinition: Active U.S. military war plans.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information revealing formally named or numbered U.S. military war plans that remain in effect.

codes.shortDefinition: Serious harm to relations between the United States and a foreign government.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information likely to cause serious harm to relations with a foreign government or ongoing diplomatic activities.

codes.shortDefinition: Protection of the President, Vice President, or other protectees.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information revealing the ability of current protection officials to protect designated individuals.

codes.shortDefinition: Emergency preparedness or national-security vulnerability.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information likely to impair current national-security emergency preparedness or reveal current vulnerabilities.

codes.shortDefinition: Restriction imposed by statute, treaty, or international agreement.
codes.detailedDefinition: A 25-year exemption for information violating a statute, treaty, or international agreement that does not permit automatic or unilateral declassification.
codes.notes: Record the cited authority when visible.

codes.shortDefinition: Restricted Data under the Atomic Energy Act.
codes.detailedDefinition: A statutory category covering specified nuclear-weapons design, production, use, and special-nuclear-material information; it is not an ordinary E.O. 13526 category.
codes.notes: Do not equate declassification under E.O. 13526 with removal of RD controls.

codes.shortDefinition: Formerly Restricted Data under the Atomic Energy Act.
codes.detailedDefinition: A statutory category for specified information removed from Restricted Data after a joint determination, chiefly relating to military utilization of atomic weapons.
codes.notes: FRD remains specially controlled and is not ordinary E.O. 13526 information.

codes.shortDefinition: The official copy reports a partial release.
codes.detailedDefinition: A literal release marking indicating that some material was withheld or removed. Nearby codes and official metadata should identify the basis where available.
codes.notes: Preserve the exact stamp or phrase; do not infer the status of absent attachments.

codes.shortDefinition: The public copy is identified as sanitized.
codes.detailedDefinition: A literal source marking that indicates the publicly released copy has material removed or obscured.
codes.notes: Normalize to a cautious partial or unclear-redactions status unless authoritative metadata supplies a controlled status.

codes.shortDefinition: Another agency is asked to review and respond concerning its information.
codes.detailedDefinition: A processing marking indicating that responsive information was sent to another agency for direct review or response under the applicable process.
codes.notes: Do not treat referral as a release determination.

codes.shortDefinition: Another agency is consulted while the original agency remains responsible for the response.
codes.detailedDefinition: A processing marking indicating that another agency's views were requested while the originating agency retains response responsibility.
codes.notes: Do not treat consultation as a release determination.

codes.shortDefinition: Locator and restriction metadata for material withheld from the reviewed file.
codes.detailedDefinition: A source-provided sheet or notice documenting removed or withheld material and usually citing a restriction basis.
codes.notes: A withdrawal sheet is not the released document. Legacy letter codes vary by collection and must not be interpreted without their page legend.
